title: Cairn A game about rocks
author: Glittering-Pie6039
selftext:
Itch had a game jam over the weekend I have never done one before but was tempted after seeing a few of the member inside the discord go at it, spent the whole day putting this together, made a few updates after a few long walks myself and coming yup with ideas for the story and the mechnics, started out as a simple 4 screen rock stacking game, turned into a full 3 year season narratice about loss and the passage of time.

New updates add a dynamic weather system which affects how easy it is to stack rocks, a rock-saving system so good stacks stay solid year round and bad ones fall over.

[https://goldenpando.itch.io/cairn](https://goldenpando.itch.io/cairn)

Give it a whirl on your PC, as that's what it was made for
